title: Opposition demonstration followed by intercommunal violence in M’Batto
threshold_50_evidence: Amnesty body gives no demonstrator attendance. No threshold evidence found in opened source; pending.

occurrence_and_date.value: Amnesty describes opposition manifestation on 9–10 November, followed by intercommunal armed clashes.

sequence_and_violence.value: Amnesty says ruling-party supporters threw stones at onset; subsequent clashes involved intercommunal armed violence and security forces were overwhelmed. Do not attribute those events or deaths to demonstrators or state action absent evidence.

state_response.value: No specific action against the demonstration established by opened Amnesty material.
